verdict.militia: Ordinary type7 only, one extra unit while retaining native/scenario defenders. foundingMilitiaContract provides a conditional successful-tail hook with command/AI origin gates; complete creator lifetime and universal event delivery remain conditions.
verdict.automaticLoyalty: Rank-neutral OR8 after retained creator return is representable. The selected defense modifier and default-stream word persistence are bound conditionally in unit-special-upgrades.json; runtime, presentation and transitive creator retention remain unproved.

guards: Do not interpret closed as implementation-ready or runtime-confirmed; it closes only this bounded feasibility question.
Do not equate a creation request with successful return, retained ownership/location, successful city founding or exactly-once allocation.
Do not label STARTYEAR2025 or STARTERA4 a proved fixed Modern Infantry grant selector; DISPLAYCARD556 is a different slot.
Do not replace existing units, reuse unknown native special IDs, or infer definition capacity from256 instance slots,100-word scratch or item routing.
Do not treat Loyalty as city loyalty, rank, an arbitrary definition bit or a proved city-only defense effect; its native special-upgrade producer is conditional.
Do not substitute earned command22 for a rank-neutral grant, set only the March bit, or grant the separate Scout upgrade by name association.
Use the exact default-stream+0x10 transfer qualification in unit-special-upgrades.json; do not infer future-turn March movement, human/AI runtime parity, multiplayer synchronization or asset support.
Do not infer an implementation contract from the feasibility verdict.
